annotations.supportSafeWording: Blocked by policy before provider work. Support can cite the Gatekeeper decision without exposing policy internals.
annotations.accessibilityNote: Terminal output uses the word blocked, a stable heading, and a remediation line rather than color alone.

annotations.annotationInput: PermissionDelta widens storage.write from preview to prod
annotations.supportSafeWording: Permission widening needs an explicit approver route; customer-safe wording names the capability class only.
annotations.accessibilityNote: Screen-reader order names the widened capability before the approval route and does not rely on icon-only emphasis.

annotations.supportSafeWording: Cost is simulated from reference fixtures; support must not present it as billed or provider-quoted spend.
annotations.accessibilityNote: Plain-text output labels this as simulated and keeps currency, source, and owner on separate lines.

annotations.annotationInput: CapacitySignal limited-region-capacity for gpu.small in us-east
annotations.supportSafeWording: Support-safe capacity wording routes to the platform-capacity owner and states that no live provider reservation is implied.
annotations.accessibilityNote: Warning text is present without color dependency and includes the blocked region and next action.

annotations.annotationInput: SloSignal checkout-latency p95 older than freshness bound
annotations.supportSafeWording: Support-safe SLO wording routes to the SRE owner and asks for refreshed evidence before readiness claims.
annotations.accessibilityNote: Terminal output says stale or unknown evidence in text and places the refresh request before any success language.

annotations.annotationInput: ApprovalRef required but absent for destructive diff
annotations.supportSafeWording: Approval runtime is out of scope; the annotation names the missing approval and safe owner route only.
annotations.accessibilityNote: Terminal-friendly wording uses a blocked heading, missing approval label, and owner route in stable order.

scopeOut: No policy engine, approval runtime, billing, quota enforcement, or provider cost API is implemented.
No live provider calls, cloud credentials, customer data, production UI, or launch claims are introduced.
No annotation may present stale, missing, or simulated evidence as live success.
